data.one_liner: A testing library for easily testing Riverpod providers.
data.what_it_does: It provides helper functions like testProvider, testNotifier, and testAsyncNotifier to simplify testing Riverpod providers and notifiers. It allows you to specify actions, expected state emissions, and verification steps.
use_when: You are using Riverpod for state management and want to write unit tests for your providers.
You want to test state changes, async values, and notifiers emitted by Riverpod.
avoid_when: Your project does not use Riverpod.
You prefer writing standard Dart test blocks without specialized testing wrappers.
strengths: Simplifies testing of various Riverpod provider types including Notifier, AsyncNotifier, and StateNotifier.
Port of bloc_test which makes it familiar for developers coming from the BLoC library.
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to the Riverpod state management library.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to your dev_dependencies.

alternatives.name: test
alternatives.why_pick_it: You prefer using core testing utilities and writing custom provider testing logic manually.
